description:
Hello! We are NASA 38TR, a team of five students from Kayseri, Türkiye. We are interested in space, science, technology, and coding.

Our project is about keeping astronauts healthy and safe in space. We want to create an AI-powered health monitoring system that checks astronauts’ heart rate, oxygen level, body temperature, and stress level. Our goal is to find possible health problems early and warn astronauts before they become serious.

We love teamwork, learning new things.
